core_categories: Single-use sterile medical/surgical products; Custom procedure packs; Theatre consumables; Medical Devices
specialty_focus: Defries Industries is an Australian-owned family medical company that designs, develops, and supplies single-use sterile medical/surgical products, custom procedure packs, and theatre consumables to healthcare providers across Australia and New Zealand. It acts as a distributor of global healthcare brands and partners with major international medical manufacturers. The company does not appear to specialize in wearable medical devices.
